new_sources.title: Finite order differentiability properties, fixed points and implicit functions over valued fields
new_sources.author: Helge Glöckner
new_sources.read_scope: Title/abstract and relevant introduction; Definition 4.4, Proposition 4.5 and its proof, Remark 4.6 equation (42), printed pp. 34–38 (PDF indices 33–37); Theorem 4.7 statement and proof opening on printed p. 38. No full induction proof or whole-paper reading claimed.
adopted_content: Uniform state contraction and appropriate existence/domain assumptions give parameter continuity and differentiability of fixed points.
Remark 4.6 equation (42) composes the inverse of I minus the state derivative with the parameter derivative.
Proposition 4.5 assumes fixed points exist for all parameters. Theorem 4.7 treats the open existence set.
new_sources.application_boundary: Actual model/input/chart dependence must be differentiated. The source supplies neither the proposed H nor a full H/He enclosure.
new_sources.fetched_text: Full text returned in EXA07-F1; text availability differs from reading scope.

new_sources.title: Affine Invariant Convergence Theorems for Newton’s Method and Extensions to Related Methods
new_sources.publication: SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis 16(1), 1–10, February 1979
new_sources.primary_source_type: Original 1979 article reproduced by OCR mirror; bibliographic identity checked at official SIAM and author publication list.
new_sources.read_scope: Section 1, printed pp. 1–3, equations (1.1)–(1.4), example (1.5)–(1.6 prime), equation (1.7). Section 2 opening displayed, but OCR-mangled radius formulas are not adopted.
adopted_content: Equations (1.3)–(1.4) give exact Newton invariance under a fixed bounded invertible residual left transformation.
The example separates identical iterates from norm-dependent convergence bounds.
new_sources.application_boundary: Full state/residual reanchoring and transformed norm/radius or interval effects remain candidate-specific proof obligations, not results attributed wholesale to this reading.

new_sources.date_note: 1979 article year; the SIAM page's 2006 online date is not treated as its publication year.
